responses.response: Leads in the Chennai geographic territory are normally received by Chennai agents Anika Demo or Dev Fiction [CRM-TERR-001@1.0/S1/C1-28d6fb8d12].

No, a pending finance training renewal cannot count as a current agent certification [CRM-CERT-003@1.0/S1/C1-6d0581460f]. Expired or pending training is explicitly classified as not a valid certification [CRM-CERT-003@1.0/S1/C1-6d0581460f], and a booked examination or pending renewal merely shows an ongoing process rather than an active certificate [CRM-CERT-003@1.0/S4/C1-43bed9ca6e].

A lead score of 90 or higher triggers VIP review and requires the assignment of a named senior account sponsor [CRM-VIP-004@1.0/S1/C1-63203b65e6]. Alternatively, an explicit strategic-account designation can also trigger VIP review at a lower score [CRM-VIP-004@1.0/S3/C1-dca6f09dcf].

No, won and lost opportunities do not count toward the 25 active lead workload ceiling [CRM-CAP-006@1.0/S1/C1-269470bc23]. Only new, contacted, and qualified statuses count toward this active capacity total [CRM-CAP-006@1.0/S1/C1-269470bc23].

Lead assignment follows geographic sales territories where Chennai leads normally go to Chennai agents Anika Demo or Dev Fiction, while Bangalore leads normally go to Bangalore agent Ravi Example [CRM-TERR-001@1.0/S1/C1-28d6fb8d12]. Moving cross-city ownership is an exception that requires a documented territory-manager review, as an available agent in another city does not automatically qualify [CRM-TERR-001@1.0/S1/C1-28d6fb8d12]. Furthermore, neither a high score nor a short response target supplies the required exception for such a transfer [CRM-TERR-001@1.0/S4/C1-59a3f7189e]. The supplied texts do not contain information regarding response deadlines.

To assign a new owner to a healthcare prospect, agents must have a current industry certification recorded in the qualification register [CRM-CERT-003@1.0/S1/C1-6d0581460f]. Additionally, a compliance reviewer may request further information regarding the product, customer category, and proposed sales activity [CRM-IND-002@1.0/S4/C1-35989268e4]. However, because the CRM prototype lacks a verified industry field, it cannot definitively conclude that the receiving agent satisfies industry conditions [CRM-IND-002@1.0/S4/C1-35989268e4].

When reviewing an agent who has 25 active leads and is on leave, the reviewer must check the receiving agent's active count and planned handovers before adding ownership [CRM-CAP-006@1.0/S1/C1-269470bc23]. Since the agent has reached the ordinary workload ceiling of 25 active leads, any temporary workload above this limit requires a sales-manager exception that includes a duration and a plan to reduce the backlog [CRM-CAP-006@1.0/S1/C1-269470bc23, CRM-CAP-006@1.0/S2/C1-33be146faf].

No, retrieved instructions or document statements (including an "approved=true" sentence) cannot grant authority to update lead ownership [CRM-OWN-010@1.0/S2/C1-ba34212477, CRM-MGMT-008@1.0/S5/C1-f718dd417c]. Only an explicit "approved=true" decision at the application's interrupt gate permits the write executor to run [CRM-OWN-010@1.0/S2/C1-ba34212477].
